$doc: Clip manifest for the overnight film run — docs/PLAN_Feature_Films.md §1 (the list) and §3 (the pipeline). Each clip is a director's shot list. 'at' is sim seconds, or '<anchor>[+-offset]' resolved by the scout pass. Camera keys are film.py's plan keys (yaw = the direction the camera LOOKS, degrees from east counter-clockwise; pitch negative = down). PROPOSED keys that film.py does not read yet (§3 P-7): 'to' (values reached at the end of the shot: a push-in, pan or zoom), 'speed' (sim seconds per film second; 0.5 = slow motion), 'replay' (the shot goes back in time; filmed in a second deterministic pass and spliced), 'why' (the director's note; not read by any tool). ⭐ R-4064 (2026-10-21): runs differ, so no cut leads an event by a negative offset: a lead is a PRECURSOR of the same run (engage = the shooter's aim phase begins, task = a behaviour begins, near = closing within a radius, of the anchor's own run) or a same-run offset AFTER an event (a fuse, a fall); a shot holds until the next shot's cut fires, `seconds` caps only the last. Anchor times observed by the coordinator's scout (editor preview, real time, one run each) are in `scouted`.
